name: Web server probed for sensitive files
description: Several requests since the last collection for files and pages attackers look for (.env, .git, backups, admin panels) from one address, seen in the log of a web server container.
remediation: Check that no such file is reachable (a 200 or 403 instead of 404 in the access log is the interesting part), block the address or rate-limit it at the proxy, and rotate any secret that was exposed.
